libwacom.reference: libwacom 2.18.0 data/wacom-isdv4-016c.tablet (HP ZBook x2 G4, Sensor Type: EMR)

guidedTest20261010.reason: Guided pen test on an HP ZBook x2 G4 with a battery-free EMR pen: pressure up to 4095 (4096 levels), tilt on both axes (about -4600..5200), eraser end reported as eraser. Side buttons not tested (the pen had none).

tiltAndCursor20261012.reason: On the HP ZBook x2 G4 (kernel 7.2.2, Hyprland 0.55.4), seen by the owner: the pen and eraser draw and hover, but with the pen tilted the hover cursor does not sit under the tip; the tilt axes are reported (capabilities.tilt) but nothing on the way to the cursor corrects the position for them. Switching from the pen back to the touchpad once left a pen cursor drawn bottom left while the touchpad pointer worked; whether the pen's leaving range reached the compositor was not checked yet.
